name: TicketAcceptanceForm
title: Accept Ticket Assignment
description: Formally accept ticket assignment and provide initial assessment to begin work

fields.name: acceptanceConfirmed
fields.label: I accept this ticket assignment and commit to working on it

validation.message: You must confirm acceptance to proceed
Please provide an estimated resolution time

fields.name: initialAssessment
fields.label: Initial Assessment
fields.placeholder: Provide your initial assessment of the issue, including any immediate observations, potential causes, or required resources...

validation.message: Initial assessment must be between 20 and 1000 characters
Please indicate if escalation is required

name: UserRegistrationForm
title: User Registration
description: Register a new user in the Help Desk Ticketing System. Complete all required fields to create your account.

validation.message: Please enter a valid email address
First name must be between 2 and 50 characters
Last name must be between 2 and 50 characters
Please enter a valid phone number
Please select a department
Please select a role
Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character
Passwords must match

name: UserProfileUpdateForm
title: Update Profile
description: Update your profile information including contact details and password. Role changes require supervisor approval.

validation.message: First name must be 2-50 characters and contain only letters
Last name must be 2-50 characters and contain only letters
Please enter a valid phone number

fields.name: currentPassword
fields.label: Current Password
fields.placeholder: Enter current password to change password

validation.message: Current password is required to set a new password

fields.name: newPassword
fields.label: New Password
fields.placeholder: Enter new password (leave blank to keep current)

validation.message: Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character
Passwords must match

name: PriorityManagementForm
title: Configure Priority Level
description: Create or update priority levels with SLA settings and escalation rules

validation.message: Priority name must be 2-50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens
Priority level must be between 1 and 10
Response time must be between 1 minute and 7 days (10080 minutes)
Resolution time must be between 1 minute and 30 days (43200 minutes)
Sort order must be between 1 and 100

name: StatusManagementForm
title: Configure Status Type
description: Create or update status types, define allowed transitions, and configure display properties for ticket workflow management.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Status Name
fields.placeholder: e.g., In Progress, Resolved, Awaiting Response

validation.message: Status name must be 2-50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens
Sort order must be between 1 and 999

fields.name: allowedTransitions
fields.label: Allowed Transitions
fields.placeholder: Select statuses this can transition to (multi-select)

name: TicketCommentForm
title: Add Comment
description: Add a comment or note to this ticket for communication between agents and users

fields.name: commentText
fields.label: Comment
fields.placeholder: Enter your comment or note here...

validation.message: Comment must be between 10 and 5000 characters
Maximum file size is 10MB

name: TicketResolutionForm
title: Resolve Ticket
description: Mark ticket as resolved by providing solution details and resolution notes

fields.name: solutionDescription
fields.label: Solution Description
fields.placeholder: Provide a clear description of the solution applied to resolve this ticket

validation.message: Solution description must be between 20 and 2000 characters

fields.name: resolutionNotes
fields.label: Resolution Notes
fields.placeholder: Add any additional notes, steps taken, or relevant information about the resolution

validation.message: Resolution notes must be between 10 and 1500 characters

fields.name: resolutionTime
fields.label: Time Spent (minutes)
fields.placeholder: Enter time spent resolving this ticket

validation.message: Time spent must be between 1 and 9999 minutes

name: TicketConfirmationForm
title: Confirm Ticket Resolution
description: Please confirm that your ticket has been resolved satisfactorily or request to reopen it

fields.name: resolutionSummary
fields.label: Resolution Summary
fields.placeholder: Summary of how the ticket was resolved

fields.name: resolutionConfirmed
fields.label: Is this issue resolved to your satisfaction?

options.label: No, I need to reopen this ticket

validation.message: Please provide a satisfaction rating

fields.name: feedback
fields.label: Additional Feedback
fields.placeholder: Please share any additional comments about the resolution or service provided

validation.message: Feedback must not exceed 1000 characters

fields.name: reopenReason
fields.label: Reason for Reopening
fields.placeholder: Please explain why you need to reopen this ticket

validation.message: Reason must not exceed 500 characters

name: TicketClosureForm
title: Close Ticket
description: Force close resolved tickets or close tickets administratively with closure reason and notes

validation.message: Please select a closure reason
Please select the final status

fields.name: closureNotes
fields.label: Closure Notes
fields.placeholder: Enter detailed notes about the ticket closure (optional)

validation.message: Closure notes must not exceed 1000 characters

fields.name: notifyUser
fields.label: Notify User
options: Send closure notification to ticket requester

name: TicketReopenForm
title: Reopen Ticket
description: Reopen a resolved ticket when the resolution is unsatisfactory or the issue persists

fields.name: ticketId
fields.label: Ticket ID
fields.placeholder: Enter the ticket ID to reopen

validation.message: Please enter a valid ticket ID (e.g., TKT-12345)

fields.name: additionalDetails
fields.label: Additional Details
fields.placeholder: Please provide detailed information about why you need to reopen this ticket and what issues you're still experiencing...

validation.message: Please provide at least 20 characters describing the issue
Accepted formats: PDF, PNG, JPG, DOC, DOCX (Max 10MB)

name: CategoryManagementForm
title: Manage Category
description: Create, update, or deactivate ticket categories and configure their properties

validation.message: Category name must be 2-100 characters and contain only letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens
Sort order must be between 1 and 999

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.placeholder: Provide a detailed description of this category and when it should be used

validation.message: Description must be between 10 and 500 characters

fields.name: defaultQueueId
fields.label: Default Queue
fields.placeholder: Select default queue for this category

name: TicketAssignmentForm
title: Assign Ticket
description: Assign or reassign ticket to an agent or queue for resolution

fields.name: assignmentReason
fields.label: Assignment Reason
fields.placeholder: Enter reason for assignment or reassignment (e.g., expertise match, workload balancing, escalation)

validation.message: Assignment reason must be between 10 and 500 characters

name: TicketSubmissionForm
title: Submit Support Ticket
description: Create a new support ticket by providing details about your issue. Our team will review and respond as soon as possible.

validation.message: Title must be between 5 and 150 characters
Please select a category
Please select a priority level

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.placeholder: Provide detailed information about your issue, including steps to reproduce if applicable

validation.message: Description must be between 20 and 2000 characters
Maximum file size is 10MB. Allowed formats: JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, XLSX

name: QueueManagementForm
title: Manage Queue
description: Create, update, or deactivate support queues and configure queue settings

fields.name: name
fields.label: Queue Name
fields.placeholder: Enter queue name (e.g., HR Benefits, Payroll Support)

validation.message: Queue name must be 3-100 characters and contain only letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens
Max capacity must be between 1 and 1000

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.placeholder: Provide a detailed description of this queue's purpose and scope

validation.message: Description must not exceed 500 characters

fields.name: assignedAgents
fields.label: Assigned Agents
fields.placeholder: Select agents to assign to this queue

validation.message: At least one agent must be assigned to the queue

fields.name: keyword
fields.label: Keyword Search
fields.placeholder: Search by ticket number, subject, or description

validation.message: Keyword must be between 2 and 100 characters
Enter a valid ticket number (e.g., TKT-12345)
Start date cannot be in the future
End date must be after start date

fields.placeholder: Add work notes, resolution details, or comments...

Maximum file size: 10MB. Allowed types: PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PNG, JPG, TXT
